about: Board certified in family law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization and Legal Counsel to the Consulate General of France, Houston, attorney Laura D. Dale practices exclusively in the area of family law. She focuses her practice on cases involving high-conflict divorce and custody cases, international abduction and other cases brought under the Hague Convention. She is fluent in French.

A certified mediator, collaborative law attorney and parenting coordinator under the Texas parenting coordinator statute, Ms. Dale has an impressive background supporting her legal practice. She obtained a master's degree in psychophysiology and a doctoral degree in neuroscience from the University Louis Pasteur in Strasbourg, France, where she served as a recherché attaché with the Centre Nationale de Recherche Scientifique and published in several internationally recognized medical journals.

Ms. Dale received her law degree from South Texas College of Law. She is licensed by the Texas Supreme Court and admitted to practice in the United States Court of Appeals for the 5th, 7th, and 10th Circuits, the Texas Eastern, Northern, Southern and Western District Courts, as well as the Texas Southern and Western Bankruptcy Courts.
